title: THE FINALS: NATIONS CUP
author: Ape Squad
description: THE FINALS is entering a new arena on July 15. Introducing THE FINALS: NATIONS CUP, a first-of-its-kind tournament presented by the Kansas City Pioneers and Sporting KC, with live broadcast production by Ape Squad.
body1:
THE FINALS is entering a whole new arena on July 15, 2026. Introducing THE FINALS: NATIONS CUP. A tournament featuring top creators, pro players, and community challengers battling for supremacy.

This premier event will be featured live on the big screen at Sporting Park during the highly anticipated Soccer Capital Gaming Experience, presented by the Kansas City Pioneers (KCP) and Sporting KC.
inlineCaption1: THE FINALS: Nations Cup kicks off live on July 15th at 1PM CT.
body2: Supported officially by Embark Studios, the entire broadcast production is powered by Ape Squad, ensuring a premium viewing experience for fans worldwide. The tournament features a live Captains Draft from the player pool, and community games. Think you and your squad have what it takes to represent your nation? Registration is officially open now. Head over to hostedbykcp.com/nations-cup to secure your spot, or tune in live on July 15 at 1PM CT at twitch.tv/pioneersgg!

description: Ape Squad is proud to bring the action to fans around the world as we co-stream the TGM26 Top 16 AMER and EMEA Qualification rounds.
body1:

inlineCaption1: The TGM26 Top 16 stage is set as the best teams in AMER and EMEA prepare to compete.
body2:
With qualification spots on the line, viewers can expect intense matchups between established contenders and rising challengers looking to make their mark on the competitive scene. The stakes have never been higher, and every match could define a team's season.

Whether you're supporting your favorite roster, scouting the competition, or simply enjoying high-level gameplay, our broadcast will ensure you don't miss a single moment of the action.

Join us live as we follow the journey of the remaining teams and witness who will emerge from the Top 16 to continue their pursuit of championship glory.
